reason: In testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/federation/storage/BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorageTest.java:255-264, testRecoveryKeysSetupAndLogin() constructs a fresh TestAppHelper, calls startLogin() and submits the recovery code, then calls testAppHelper.logout() (ignoring its boolean return value) without calling completeLogin(). Because refreshToken is only populated in TestAppHelper.completeLogin() (testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/util/TestAppHelper.java:70-74), logout() at line 101-103 posts to the logout endpoint without a refresh_token parameter and fails silently, leaving the session behind.
